title: Magnetic field
description: Fine white field lines bend between a pair of quiet cobalt poles.
useCase: Science, research, or a precise generative identity built from directional flow.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Qualitative two-pole illustration, not a calibrated electromagnetic field solver.
look: Deep navy field with fine pale-blue curved field lines looping between a bright red-orange dot and a pale grey-white dot, flat and diagrammatic.
motion: The two poles bob vertically in opposition on a slow 33-second sine, so the field lines continuously bend between them; the separation slider moves the poles apart or together.
adapt: Pole positions `a` and `b` (spaced by `sep`, bobbing with `u_time*.19`) and line density `11.0` live in `main` of `FRAGMENT`; the base colour is `c` and `red` marks one pole. `controlRef` feeds `u_control`; keep the context-loss fallback.
